records.reason: workflow.yaml#@element: The complete qualification workflow starts at run and has the sole graph exit run.done -> null. A workflow graph node, exit or activity reference is neither a routine invocation argument contract nor a routine step.output export, the two AP-02 scopes.

run.yaml#@relationship/5a93bb0629055f53: The concrete activity call supplies envelope to deliver, whose input is envelope and whose emit step calls produce. AP-02 contract (1) applies to this concrete invocation or its argument/target constituent: its key set must be compared with deliver Inputs. Both a matching and a different key set remain applicable.

produce.md#@relationship/f075d23fadb959c8: The inheritance relationship connects produce Destination archive to its executing workflow ancestor requirement archive. This relationship carries destination inheritance, not an activity argument contract or exported routine-output binding. The leaf output contract belongs to its separate declaration and producer-call rows.

deliver.yaml#@element: The complete deliver routine declares input envelope, exports report through emit.report, and calls produce in emit. AP-02 contract (2) applies to the emit.report export or this explicitly named producer/output endpoint. The entry requires resolution of emit and produce before comparing the exported output with the declared name.
